proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition variant on spell Effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Charm Monster's onFail outcome is a condition (Charmed), not damage. The spell Effect type only allows DamageEffect | NoneEffect. The apply_condition atom exists in v4 but is not reachable from a spell save_gate phase. A new variant { kind: 'apply_condition'; condition: Condition } on Effect (mirroring the mastery SaveGateRiderResult shape) is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it.

proposed_widenings.name: conditional_break variant (or field) on timed Duration
proposed_widenings.justification: The charm breaks early if the caster or allies deal damage to the target. The timed Duration variant only carries a DurationValue (amount + unit). There is no way to express 'also breaks when event X occurs'. A break-event field or a new Duration variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it

proposed_widenings.name: contextual save advantage modifier on save_gate phase
proposed_widenings.justification: The target rolls its saving throw with Advantage if it is currently being fought by the caster or allies. There is no surface slot on ActivationPhase save_gate (or on the spell header) to express a conditional advantage modifier on the target's roll at cast time.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it.

notes: Primary blocker is the missing apply_condition variant on spell Effect — this is the same atom used in mastery save_gate riders but not exposed on the spell side. The conditional duration break and contextual save-advantage modifier are secondary widenings that would also be required for a complete encoding. No .dhall or .json authored because the primary mechanic cannot be honestly represented.
